video_caption: The video segment opens on a black background, with a portrait of Isaac Newton in the top-left corner, and the handwritten word "Newton" beneath it. In the bottom-center of the screen, a glowing yellow lightbulb is depicted, surrounded by several short, yellow arrows pointing outwards from it, suggesting emitted light rays or particles. A white cursor, shaped like a hand, appears at 0:05, moving to highlight different yellow arrows around the lightbulb, first emphasizing the arrows on the left side, then briefly moving to an upward-pointing arrow, and finally returning to the lower-left arrows, indicating the directional emission from the bulb.

The video segment opens on a black background, featuring a portrait of Isaac Newton in the top-left corner, depicted with long white hair and dark attire. Below his portrait, the name "Newton" is handwritten in white. Below this text, a bright yellow lightbulb is shown, emitting yellow arrows radially outwards in multiple directions, symbolizing light as particles. At 0:04, a new section appears on the right side of the screen. In the top-right corner, a black and white engraving of Christiaan Huygens is displayed, showing him with long, curly hair. Below his portrait, the name "Huygens" is handwritten. Underneath this text, another identical yellow lightbulb is presented, but this one is surrounded by circular ripples on a textured grey background that resembles stones or pebbles, suggesting light as waves. A white cursor briefly points at the "Huygens" text and then the lightbulb on the right side of the screen between 0:08 and 0:13. The scene remains static from 0:04 to 0:14, showcasing a visual contrast between Newton's particle theory of light and Huygens' wave theory of light.

The video begins with a split screen, featuring two historical figures and their proposed theories of light. On the left, a portrait of Isaac Newton is shown above the text "Newton". Below his image, a cartoon lightbulb emits straight yellow arrows in multiple directions, visually representing his particle theory of light. On the right, a portrait of Christiaan Huygens is displayed above the text "Huygens". Below his image, a cartoon lightbulb is situated on a textured surface resembling pebbles or stones, with concentric ripples emanating outwards from it, illustrating his wave theory of light. A white cursor hand points at this lightbulb. The scene then transitions to a full-screen shot of a water surface. A single yellow liquid drop falls into a pool of blue liquid, creating a prominent set of spreading concentric ripples. The water surface reflects the yellow and blue colors of the liquids. A white cursor hand points to the center of these ripples as the speaker discusses water waves.

The video opens with a black screen, on the right side of which is a vibrant still image depicting a single yellow liquid drop creating concentric ripples on a surface that reflects blue and yellow light. A white cursor, shaped like a pointing hand, moves across the upper part of the black screen. At the 0:13 mark, the cursor moves to the upper left and begins "writing" in an orange-brown hue. It first writes "Aether," followed by "Medium" at 0:16, resulting in the text "Aether Medium." Immediately after, the cursor underlines both words with a wavy line. At 0:35, the cursor moves to the left and writes the word "Light" in the same orange-brown color. By 0:38, it draws an arrow pointing from "Light" to "Aether Medium," establishing the relationship "Light -> Aether Medium." The cursor then remains static near the arrow, with all the handwritten text and the image of the water drop visible on the black background.

The video segment features a computer screen displaying two visual elements. On the left, a media player window shows an animation on a black background, with a glowing light bulb in the bottom left. From the light bulb, numerous small, yellow-orange dots are arranged in concentric arcs and radial lines, appearing to simulate particles in a medium. A white hand-shaped cursor is visible, interacting with the animation. Above this, at the top of the main screen, the text "Light -> Aether Medium" is handwritten in yellow and orange. To the right of the animation window, a smaller, static image displays abstract, swirling patterns of blue and yellow colors.

The video segment presents a split-screen view contrasting two types of waves. On the left, a digital animation within a macOS window titled "Visualising light (wave).mp4" displays a glowing lightbulb at the bottom, emitting numerous small yellow dots arranged in concentric circles and radial lines on a black background, visually representing light waves. Two prominent white arcs delineate sections of these expanding patterns, and a white mouse cursor navigates over them and the lightbulb. Concurrently, on the right, a smaller, vibrant image depicts a single water droplet falling into a pool of liquid, creating clear concentric ripples on its surface, which is adorned with swirling patterns of blue and yellow. A white mouse cursor also moves over these water ripples. Overlaying the top right of the screen, handwritten text in yellow reads "Light ->," followed by "Aether Medium" in orange, underlined with a wavy stroke. A male narrator's voice explains the concepts of "ripples of light" and "ripples of water," specifically pointing out that the water waves are two-dimensional and circular, existing on the surface.

The video opens with a screen displaying a video player window on a black background. Inside the player, a glowing light bulb is positioned at the bottom left, emitting light that radiates outwards as concentric, shimmering yellow dotted patterns, resembling spherical waves expanding from the source. Several white curved lines are also visible, highlighting some of these spherical patterns. A white mouse cursor is occasionally seen moving across these dotted patterns. At the bottom of the video player are standard controls like play/pause buttons, a progress bar, and volume controls, with the title "VisualizingLight(wave).mp4" at the top. To the right of the video player, a smaller, static image shows a blue and yellow liquid surface being hit by a droplet, creating visible ripples. In the top right corner of the overall screen, above the static image, handwritten text reads "Light -> Aether Medium" in yellow and orange. The spoken audio describes these expanding light patterns as "spherical ripples" and a "3D wave," contrasting them with simple circles.

The video opens with a black background featuring two handwritten-style texts at the top: "Ripples" on the left and "Light -> Aether Medium" on the right, with "Light" in yellow and "Aether Medium" underlined. Below "Light -> Aether Medium" is a still image of a water drop splashing into a liquid, creating concentric ripples; the liquid reflects blue and yellow colors. From 0:00 to 0:04, a white hand-shaped cursor appears, briefly hovers over "Ripples," moves below it, then reappears and moves to underline the word "Wavefronts" which then appears below "Ripples."

The video segment opens with a black background featuring handwritten text on the left and an animated image on the right. On the left, in white text, are the words "Ripples" and "Wavefronts," with an arrow pointing from "Wavefronts" to "Set of particles in sync ("phase")" which is written out by a white cursor in real-time. Above the animated image on the right, in yellow text, are the words "Light -> Aether Medium," with "Aether Medium" underlined. The animated image depicts a single drop of water falling into a pool, generating concentric ripples across the water's surface, which reflects vibrant blue and yellow/gold hues. As the video progresses, blue dots appear on one of the inner circular ripples, connected by dashed lines to a central reference line, illustrating the up-and-down movement of particles on the wave crest. The white cursor then points to these dots, emphasizing their synchronous oscillation. Later, a second set of blue dots and dashed lines appears on an outer ripple, also demonstrating the synchronized movement of particles, representing a trough. The speaker explains that "wavefronts" are a "set of particles in sync ('phase')" with each other. Finally, the animated image fades away, leaving only the text on the black screen.

The video segment opens with a screen recording showing a video player displaying an animation. The animation features a glowing light bulb on a black background, from which concentric circles composed of yellow dots expand outwards, simulating waves. On the left side of the screen, handwritten notes are visible, initially showing "Ripples" and "Wave" with arrows. The speaker uses a hand cursor to highlight one of the circles of dots, demonstrating that all dots within that circle are vibrating in sync. The video is paused and replayed several times to emphasize this synchronized vibration. In the background, to the right of the video player, a smaller, static image of water ripples caused by a droplet is visible. At 00:37, the video player disappears, revealing the full handwritten notes on the black background: "“Ripples”" (with a down arrow), "Wavefronts" (underlined, with a down arrow), "↳ Set of particles" (with a down arrow), and "in sync (“phase”)". Above the water ripple image, the text "Light → Aether Medium" is displayed. A hand cursor briefly points to the center of the water ripple image, where the droplet makes contact.

The video segment opens with a split screen on a black background. On the left, handwritten white text defines "Ripples" and "Wavefronts" as a "Set of particles in sync ('phase')". Above the right side, green text reads "Light" and orange text below it says "Aether Medium," suggesting a comparison. The bottom right shows a static image of a water drop falling into a blue and yellow body of water, creating perfectly circular ripples that expand outward. A white cursor briefly appears over the ripples. A male voice explains the concept of ripples and wavefronts, using the water as an analogy. At 0:22, the water ripple image shrinks and slides to the right, revealing an animation on the left. This animation features a glowing light bulb at the bottom, emitting concentric, expanding circles of yellow dots, illustrating light wavefronts radiating from a source in a 3D perspective. A grey window title bar at the top of this animation reads "Wavefronts-fantasy.mp4". The handwritten text and the "Light -> Aether Medium" text remain visible on the black background throughout this transition.

The video segment opens with a Mac-style video player displaying an animation on a black background. At the bottom center of the animation, a glowing light bulb emits light, visualized as numerous small yellow dots arranged in radial lines extending outwards. Several white circular arcs, representing wavefronts, are shown expanding from the light bulb. On the black background to the left of the video player, handwritten text reads "Rip" above "Wa," with an arrow pointing from "Wa" towards the wavefronts, likely indicating "Rip Wavefronts" or a similar concept. To the right of the video player, a static, abstract image with swirling patterns of blue and yellow is present. Throughout the segment, a white cursor shaped like a hand moves around the video, pointing at the light bulb and the expanding wavefronts as the speaker explains how the wavefronts would appear spherical when viewed from a distance, akin to ripples. The speaker then asks the viewer to pause the video and consider the shape of the wavefronts when viewed from an extremely far distance, emphasizing the massive size the spherical wavefront would achieve. The video is paused by the speaker at 0:55, with the circular wavefronts still visible in their expanded state.

The video segment displays a screen recording of a Mac OS X video player showing an animation with a black background. At the bottom center of the animation, a glowing light bulb emits expanding, concentric yellow dotted circles, representing spherical wavefronts. Two thick, grey, curved lines are also visible, cutting across these wavefronts. Handwritten text on the left side of the screen reads "Rip" and "Wa", with a curved arrow pointing from "Wa" towards the wavefronts, likely abbreviating "Ripples" and "Wavefronts." As the video plays, it quickly "zooms out" or "moves far away" from the light source. Consequently, the curved yellow dotted wavefronts progressively flatten and appear as straighter, more parallel lines of dots, resembling plane waves. Simultaneously, the grey curved lines also become straighter and more vertical, maintaining a slight curve, until they appear as almost perfectly straight, vertical bars. The background on the right side of the screen features a static image of abstract blue and yellow swirls.

The video displays a black background with handwritten text on the left and a dynamic image on the right. The text on the left, primarily in white with some yellow highlights, explains concepts related to waves: "Ripples", "Wavefronts", and "Set of particles in sync (“phase”)". Below this, there are two categorized descriptions: "Point" (pointing to "Spherical" below it) and "Source far away" (pointing to "Plane" below it), indicating the shape of wavefronts based on the source's distance. In the top center, green text reads "Light" followed by a right arrow, and then underlined orange text reads "Aether Medium". On the right side of the screen, a high-definition image shows a water droplet just having impacted a water surface, generating clear, concentric circular ripples. The water itself is a vibrant mix of blue and yellow, creating a visually striking contrast.
